description: Keeps the engine lubricated, reduces friction, and helps prevent premature engine wear.
details: Use the oil grade recommended in the owner manual. Check the oil level regularly if the car is driven in traffic, heat, or dusty conditions.

description: Improves airflow to the engine and can help with fuel economy and acceleration response.
details: A dirty air filter can make the engine work harder. Inspect sooner if the vehicle is driven on dusty roads.

description: Helps keep dust, pollen, and odors out of the cabin air system.
details: Replace it sooner if the air conditioner smells bad or airflow from the vents feels weak.

description: Checks brake pad thickness, rotor condition, and possible brake noise causes.
details: Squealing, grinding, vibration, or longer stopping distance means the brakes should be inspected immediately.

description: Removes moisture-contaminated brake fluid and supports safe braking performance.
details: Brake fluid absorbs moisture over time. Old fluid can reduce braking performance and damage brake components.

interval: Every 20,000 miles or when symptoms appear
description: Checks for leaks, bouncing, clunking, uneven tire wear, and reduced ride control.
details: Worn struts can affect comfort, steering stability, braking distance, and tire wear.

description: Helps tires wear evenly and can extend tire life.
details: Uneven tire wear may also point to alignment, suspension, or tire pressure issues.

interval: Every year or after suspension work
description: Helps the car track straight and reduces uneven tire wear.
details: Alignment should be checked after replacing struts, tie rods, control arms, or after hitting a large pothole.

description: Checks battery health, charging voltage, and starting reliability.
details: Battery weakness can cause hard starts, warning lights, or electrical issues. Heat can shorten battery life.

description: Confirms headlights, brake lights, turn signals, reverse lights, and cabin lights work correctly.
details: If several interior lights stop working together, check the fuse, switch position, bulb condition, and wiring.

description: Helps prevent overheating and protects the cooling system.
details: Never open the radiator cap when the engine is hot. Low coolant may indicate a leak.

description: Checks fluid level and condition to support smooth shifting.
details: Dark, burnt-smelling fluid or rough shifting should be checked by a qualified technician.

description: Supports smooth engine performance, fuel economy, and reliable starting.
details: Misfires, rough idle, or poor acceleration can be signs of worn spark plugs or ignition components.

description: Can help with rough idle, hesitation, or sticky throttle response.
details: Cleaning should be done carefully with the correct cleaner and procedure to avoid sensor or throttle plate damage.

description: Checks sensors, wiring, calibration, and warning indicators for the blind spot system.
details: After rear body damage or bumper work, blind spot sensors may need inspection or calibration.
